pattern: Static text: no role; the label is read in document order with the content it classifies.

keyboard.action: Not focusable; read in document order by assistive technology.

notes: The label carries the meaning; tone colors, the dot, and the icon are decorative, so meaning never depends on color alone.
A badge that changes while the user works is not announced; use Inline Message with live set for that.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
